purpose: Ten independent, source-locked four-frame idle loops. All five returned frames per job were downloaded and visually reviewed.

jobs.review: All five frames clean: head, club, chain, palette, transparency, planted feet, and subtle breathing loop remain source-safe.
Intermediate frames expose and redraw the face under the hood; the source identity requires the face to remain hidden.
All five frames preserve the canine head, limbs, paws, palette, transparency, and silhouette; breathing and ear motion are clean and restrained.
All five frames preserve the carved head, body, palette, transparency, and grounded silhouette; the settling motion is subtle but visible.
All five frames preserve head, barrel, palette, transparency, and feet. The shoulder/balance loop is readable without attack anticipation.
All five frames preserve face, hands, robe, icy base, palette, transparency, and hover position; hem/sleeve drift is clean.
White spore/smoke-like particles appear beside the cap in intermediate frames; gameplay-owned effects are not permitted in the sprite.
A new orange ground-flame effect appears beside the character; it is a gameplay effect outside the source sprite.
All five frames preserve the hooded head, hook, cleaver, palette, transparency, and planted silhouette; breathing loop is clean.
All five frames preserve head, hammer, armor, palette, transparency, and silhouette; slow breathing motion is clean.
